qas.query:
I’m adding a small entertainment block to an upcoming trip and want a tight shortlist from the available resource brief. Build a ranked shortlist of exactly two event names, ordered 1-2, and give one short fit reason for each. Do not include any other events.

Available resource brief:
- Meridian Futures Weekend, Vancouver: three-day festival of novels, film adaptations, and panels on future societies; most sessions in English; author Q&A and informal discussion spaces.
- After Hours at the Maritime Museum, Lisbon: late entry with a sound installation, bar service, and open mingling; very little scheduled programming.
- Phantom Atlas Escape Room, Berlin: 75-minute team puzzle set in a dystopian city; fast pace, timed rounds, no facilitated discussion afterward.
- World Stories Book Salon, Kuala Lumpur: guided English-language discussion on translated historical fiction in a small group.
- Cinema of Possible Worlds, Dublin: evening screening of a new speculative feature followed by a moderated audience discussion in English.
- Night Laughs Showcase, Toronto: stand-up set with crowd work, drinks service, and a social mixer after the show.

qas.query:
I want to narrow a short personal break to two candidates before I look at flights. Use the available resource brief to build a ranked two-city shortlist for a four-day trip. Return exactly two city names in order, with one short sentence for each explaining why it survives the cut. Do not add any other cities.

Available resource brief:
- Kyoto — very large historic city with abundant temples, gardens, and old districts; excellent transport and depth, but many marquee areas draw steady daytime crowds.
- Luang Prabang — small UNESCO town with monastery-lined streets, river edges, and a slower daily rhythm; easy to cover on foot.
- George Town — layered heritage core with shophouses, murals, and strong food culture; visually rich but often lively and traffic-heavy.
- Nara — compact former capital with major temple and shrine precincts, wooded walking routes, and quiet early hours; busiest around the main park by late morning.
- Ayutthaya — ruined capital with striking religious remains and river scenery; more spread out and sun-exposed across the day.
- Kanazawa — beautifully preserved districts, formal gardens, and river paths; composed and photogenic, with fewer temple-centered days than some other options.
